claims.text: The latest stable release of Pulumi (pulumi/pulumi) as of 2026-09-21 is v3.263.0, released 2026-09-16 (the at-a-glance table at L134 lists v3.261.0 released 2026-09-02).
The latest stable release of Terraform as of 2026-09-21 is v1.16.3, released 2026-09-16 (the at-a-glance table at L135 lists v1.16.1 released 2026-09-02).
The latest stable release of AWS CDK as of 2026-09-21 is v2.270.0, released 2026-09-17 (the at-a-glance table at L136 lists v2.268.0 released 2026-09-02).
The latest stable release of Azure Bicep is v0.47.16, released 2026-09-08.
The latest stable release of Kubernetes is v1.37.0, released 2026-08-26.
The latest stable release of Crossplane is v2.4.1, released 2026-09-15 (the at-a-glance table at L142 still lists v2.4.0).
The latest stable release of OpenTofu is v1.12.6, released 2026-08-19.
Version and release-date figures were checked against each project's GitHub releases on 2026-09-21.
GitHub star counts: Pulumi ~25.7k, Terraform ~49.7k, AWS CDK ~12.9k, Azure Bicep ~3.6k, Kubernetes ~127.9k, Crossplane ~12.1k, OpenTofu ~30.2k.

Among dedicated IaC tools, Terraform is the most-starred, followed by OpenTofu, Pulumi, AWS CDK, and Crossplane, and Kubernetes leads the broader infrastructure ecosystem by GitHub stars (measured 2026-09-21).

Terraform's larger community reflects a decade of first-mover adoption, while Pulumi, OpenTofu, and Crossplane have grown fastest among teams prioritizing general-purpose languages, open governance, or Kubernetes-native management respectively.
Spacelift's paid plans scale by private worker count rather than seats or resources, with quote-based pricing at the top end.
env0 is now named env zero, and env zero prices its paid tiers per successful apply or environment.
Google Cloud Deployment Manager reached end of support on March 31, 2026.
Google Cloud Deployment Manager will be fully turned down on June 30, 2027.
Google Cloud Infrastructure Manager replaces Google Cloud Deployment Manager.
Pulumi Cloud's Free edition is free forever for one user with unlimited stacks and projects and 500 workflow minutes per month.
Pulumi Cloud Essentials starts at $40/month with 40 credits included and up to 500 managed resources.
Pulumi Cloud Pro starts at $400/month with 400 credits included and up to 2,000 managed resources.
Pulumi Cloud Enterprise pricing is custom and contract-priced.
HCP Terraform is free for up to 500 managed resources with one concurrent run, then costs roughly $0.10 to $0.99 per resource per month depending on tier, with Terraform Enterprise at custom pricing.
The pricing figures reflect published pricing as of September 2026 (checked 2026-09-21).
Open-source tools including OpenTofu, Kubernetes, and Crossplane are free to run, and cloud-native tools like CDK, CloudFormation, ARM, Bicep, and Infrastructure Manager carry no separate tool fee.
